question:
Choose the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase.

What we need is skilled and energetic planning and __elbow grease__.

options.text: The grease that is earned through labour
Hard work that one puts into cleaning one’s elbow
Hard work that one puts into removing grease
Hard work that one puts into doing something

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Elbow grease:** This phrase metaphorically refers to putting in physical or hard work to accomplish tasks.(कार्यों को पूरा करने के लिए शारीरिक या कड़ी मेहनत करना।)
 
• "Elbow grease" symbolises "Hard work that one puts into doing something".

Therefore, the correct interpretation is **"Hard work that one puts into doing something".**
